sources.title: ukisai/Swift-Qwen3.8-27b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B is UkisAI's reasoning-efficient derivative of Qwen3.8-27B, using 58.3% fewer thinking tokens while maintaining near-identical performance (<1% loss) and as a result getting a x1.95 speed-up on several tasks.

sources.title: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B: less overthinking | UkisAI
sources.snippet: AIME uses template-default effort and counts truncated answers as incorrect, so it is a separate comparison from the BF16 math results. The full model is available on Hugging Face. Serve it with vLLM or SGLang, using a build that supports Qwen3.8. Adjust tensor parallelism and context length to your GPU memory. ... vllm serve ukisai/Swift-Qwen3.8-27b \ --dtype bfloat16 \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 \ --max-model-len 262144 \ --reasoning-parser qwen3 \ --enable-auto-tool-choice \ --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder \ --port 8000
